scenes.text: Twenty forty-eight dollars, to prove anyone can run their own Farcaster. No API keys. No permission.
Hetzner said no. AWS said no. Azure was sold out, until it wasn't.
Eleven hours later, half a terabyte of Farcaster.
Except one shard. Five hundred and seventy days behind.
Its snapshot vanished mid-download. So I fixed it, and sent the fix upstream.
An hour later, fully in sync.
Then my seed phrase, once. The client made its own key. No gas.
And I posted. From my own node.
Three commands. Your own Farcaster. Your turn.
